intro: Prehistoric Prism is an exploratory quest directing adventurers to transport a multifaceted titan relic from the Wetlands to Ironforge. Entrusted by Prospector Whelgar, the relic is donated to High Explorer Magellas in the Hall of Explorers to further the League's study of the ancient keepers.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: With titan-like inscriptions like that on its facets, nothing less than Ironforge's Hall of Explorers is the right place to bring it.
I'd like to think that you'll be noted in the history for it in the catalogue -- "Recovered by friend! Authenticated by Prospector Whelgar..." Ah, I'm gettin' meself carried away.
High Explorer Magellas will receive you, and given the exquisite nature of what you carry, will surely be most generously appreciative should you donate it to the museum.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have a look at our gallery, but please, don't touch the artifacts, unless it's one you're here to donate to the library.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Woah! Look at this marvel! The light through it dances like nothin' I've seen since my first dig in old Uldaman. The marks of the keepers on this cannot be mistaken.
You've done the League a great service bringin' this home. A find like this pushes the very boundaries o' the world's wisdom forward.
We'll be sure to record the details of your contribution! Truly a job well done, adventurer.
